scope: Preliminary complete construction and commissioning of a rapid-gravity potable-water filtration station from primary cell geometry and selected process-package facts. Civil structures and envelope, filter media and underdrain, wash-water and air systems, internal pipework and valves, instrumentation, electrical and control systems, consumables, testing, labor, mechanisms, procurement balance and logistics are calculated by the canonical compiler from ten ordinary facts and a visible editable engineering profile.
calculatedScope: reinforced-concrete filter cells and building envelope
formwork, waterstops, waterproofing, lining and curing
filter media, support gravel, underdrain blocks, nozzles and wash troughs
internal inlet, outlet, wash-water, air and drain pipework
process valves, joints, supports and installation consumables
backwash pumps, blowers, receiver and process instruments
MCC, PLC, power and control cabling, trays and earthing
test water, disinfection reagent, commissioning and records
civil, process, electrical and commissioning labor
earthmoving, concrete, lifting, welding and testing mechanisms
concrete, media, equipment and surplus-soil logistics
filter-media procurement need, packages, ordered quantity and remainder
excludedScope: raw-water intake and pumping outside the filtration-station boundary
coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation and disinfection process blocks
clean-water reservoirs and external distribution pipelines
unconfirmed site shoring, groundwater control and standby generation
prices or manufacturer performance not supplied by a confirmed source
truthBoundary: This is a visible preliminary engineering profile, not an approved universal design or rate. Every profile assumption remains editable and requires confirmation by the project, process designer or selected supplier before contract use. Derived final quantities are never ordinary questionnaire inputs.
